basic_info.description: Country Club Living on Potrero Hill. This bright and updated 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms condominium at Victoria Mews delivers the best of San Francisco living on the north slope of Potrero Hill, one of the city's sunniest neighborhoods.     The home features newly installed engineered hardwood floors, updated lighting, custom cabinetry, modern hardware, in-unit washer/dryer, and a cozy wood-burning fireplace  all opening to a private deck with stunning skyline views.     Designed for both relaxation and recreation, Victoria Mews offers a rare suite of amenities: swimming pool, tennis courts, gym, sauna, clubhouse, and landscaped grounds (and your very own babbling creek!) all under Potrero Hill's signature sunshine. With one-car garage parking and deeded storage, this home offers a living style worth savoring.     The North Slope Potrero Hill location means the property is close to Whole Foods, 18th & 20 th Streets shopping districts, UCSF, Caltrain, and I-280 & 101.
